# Spectra fixtures — provenance

Most files here are copies or trimmed excerpts of the **Avogadro 1** test corpus
(`avogadro-master/testfiles/`, upstream <https://github.com/cryos/avogadro>). Avogadro 1 is
licensed **GPL-2.0-or-later**; the `testfiles/COPYING` file in that directory additionally
carries a BSD-3-Clause notice (© 2006 Jerome Pansanel). Atomscope is GPL-3.0-or-later, which is
compatible with both. Excerpts keep only the blocks the parsers need; nothing was edited.

| File | Origin | Trimmed from |
|---|---|---|
| `methane.g03` | `testfiles/methane.g03` | input orientation + `Harmonic frequencies` section |
| `methane_qchem.out` | `testfiles/methane.out` (a Q-Chem output despite the name) | complete |
| `ch3oh_nmr.qcout` | `testfiles/ch3oh-nmr.qcout` | nuclear orientation + NMR shielding section |
| `caffeine_orca.out` | `testfiles/koffein_orca.out` (2.8 MB) | final geometry, `VIBRATIONAL FREQUENCIES`, `NORMAL MODES`, `IR SPECTRUM`, ZPE |
| `sampleIRSpectra.tsv` | `testfiles/sampleIRSpectra.tsv` | first 400 rows |
| `methanol.jdx` | `testfiles/methanol.jdx` (NIST/Coblentz Society, public domain) | complete |
| `turbomole_spectrum` | `testfiles/spectrum` | complete |
| `turbomole_cdspectrum` | `testfiles/cdspectrum` | complete |

## Synthetic fixture

`benzene_freq.g03` is **not** from the corpus. `testfiles/benzene.g03` is a geometry
optimisation with no frequency section, and no other file in the corpus has a 30-mode Gaussian
frequency block, so this file was generated by `.scratch/make_benzene_fixture.py` to exercise the
Gaussian parser on a full `3N-6 = 30` mode set. Frequencies are the gas-phase experimental
benzene fundamentals with their D6h symmetry labels (7 IR-active modes: `A2U` + 3 × `E1U`);
the displacement vectors are deterministic pseudo-random unit vectors, **not** physical normal
coordinates. Only the file layout and the frequency/intensity/symmetry values are meaningful.
